paragraphs.en: Agent Executor (AX) is Google's open agentic orchestration runtime
paragraphs.zh: Agent Executor (AX) 是 Google 开放的智能体编排运行时

paragraphs.en: AX and several of its features are in heavy development. We are actively refining our core concepts, protocols, and specifications, and will likely introduce major breaking changes prior to a stable release.
paragraphs.zh: AX 及其多项功能正处于密集开发阶段。 我们正在积极打磨核心概念、协议与规范，在稳定版本发布之前，很可能会引入重大的破坏性变更。

paragraphs.en: Declare an agentic task with workspaces and model specifications. AX sandboxes it, wires up its workspace, and helps running it at scale.
paragraphs.zh: 声明一个带工作区和模型规范的智能体任务。 AX 对其进行沙箱隔离，连接好其工作区，并帮助其大规模运行。

sents.en: Declare an agentic task with workspaces and model specifications.
sents.zh: 声明一个带工作区和模型规范的智能体任务。

sents.en: AX sandboxes it, wires up its workspace, and helps running it at scale.
sents.zh: AX 对其进行沙箱隔离，连接好其工作区，并帮助其大规模运行。

paragraphs.en: AX is a high-throughput, declarative orchestrator to run billions of autonomous agent workloads in a cluster. It runs on top of Agent Substrate for sandboxed execution and is built to run billions of tasks per cluster. If you have used Kubernetes, ax will feel similar.
paragraphs.zh: AX 是一个高吞吐、声明式的编排器，用于在集群中运行数十亿个自主智能体工作负载。 它运行在 Agent Substrate 之上以实现沙箱化执行，并且被构建为可在每个集群中运行数十亿个任务。 如果你用过 Kubernetes，ax 会让你感觉很相似。

sents.en: AX is a high-throughput, declarative orchestrator to run billions of autonomous agent workloads in a cluster.
sents.zh: AX 是一个高吞吐、声明式的编排器，用于在集群中运行数十亿个自主智能体工作负载。

sents.en: It runs on top of Agent Substrate for sandboxed execution and is built to run billions of tasks per cluster.
sents.zh: 它运行在 Agent Substrate 之上以实现沙箱化执行，并且被构建为可在每个集群中运行数十亿个任务。

sents.en: If you have used Kubernetes, ax will feel similar.
sents.zh: 如果你用过 Kubernetes，ax 会让你感觉很相似。

paragraphs.en: # task.yaml apiVersion : ax.io/v1alpha1 kind : Workspace metadata : name : golang spec : git : - repo : https://github.com/golang/go.git branch : " my-fix " --- apiVersion : ax.io/v1alpha1 kind : Task metadata : name : test spec : workspace : name : golang goal : " Ensure that Go tool chain is available and is built from source " debug : true # lets you `ax ssh` into the sandbox Then apply it, watch it come up, and look over the agent's shoulder:
paragraphs.zh: # task.yaml apiVersion : ax.io/v1alpha1 kind : Workspace metadata : name : golang spec : git : - repo : https://github.com/golang/go.git branch : " my-fix " --- apiVersion : ax.io/v1alpha1 kind : Task metadata : name : test spec : workspace : name : golang goal : " 确保Go工具链可用，并且是从源码构建的 " debug : true # 允许你通过 `ax ssh` 进入沙箱 然后应用它，观察它启动，并从智能体背后查看进展：

paragraphs.en: ax apply -f task.yaml ax watch task test ax ssh test -- ls -al /workspace Why? Agents are a new kind of workload. They are neither stateless microservices nor run-to-completion batch jobs. They accumulate state, need strict isolation, call out to model APIs and tool servers, and can burn money in a loop if nobody is watching. AX gives you three small primitives that handle all of that declaratively:
paragraphs.zh: ax apply -f task.yaml ax watch task test ax ssh test -- ls -al /workspace 为什么？ 智能体是一种新型的负载。 它们既不是无状态微服务，也不是运行即完成的批处理作业。 它们会积累状态，需要严格隔离，要调用模型 API 和工具服务器，而且如果没人看管，可能会陷入循环烧钱。 AX 为你提供了三个小原语，以声明式的方式处理所有这些事情：

sents.en: ax apply -f task.yaml ax watch task test ax ssh test -- ls -al /workspace Why?
sents.zh: ax apply -f task.yaml ax watch task test ax ssh test -- ls -al /workspace 为什么？

sents.en: AX gives you three small primitives that handle all of that declaratively:
sents.zh: AX 为你提供了三个小原语，以声明式的方式处理所有这些事情：

paragraphs.en: Everything is expressed as ax.io/v1alpha1 manifests and applied with a single command.
paragraphs.zh: 一切均以 ax.io/v1alpha1 清单（manifest）的形式表达，并可通过单条命令应用。

paragraphs.en: AX schedules every task as a sandboxed actor on Agent Substrate , so Substrate must be running in your cluster before you deploy AX. You need:
paragraphs.zh: AX 将每个任务调度为 Agent Substrate 上的沙箱化智能体（actor），因此在部署 AX 之前，必须在你的集群中运行 Substrate。你需要：

paragraphs.en: To install Agent Substrate, follow the instructions in the Substrate README . Substrate lands in the ate-system namespace and exposes its Control API at api.ate-system.svc.cluster.local:443 , which is where AX expects to find it. Verify it is up before moving on:
paragraphs.zh: 要安装 Agent Substrate，请按照 Substrate README 中的说明操作。 Substrate 会部署在 ate-system 命名空间中，并在 api.ate-system.svc.cluster.local:443 上暴露其 Control API，这正是 AX 期望找到它的位置。 在继续之前，请先确认它已启动运行：

sents.en: To install Agent Substrate, follow the instructions in the Substrate README .
sents.zh: 要安装 Agent Substrate，请按照 Substrate README 中的说明操作。

sents.en: Substrate lands in the ate-system namespace and exposes its Control API at api.ate-system.svc.cluster.local:443 , which is where AX expects to find it.
sents.zh: Substrate 会部署在 ate-system 命名空间中，并在 api.ate-system.svc.cluster.local:443 上暴露其 Control API，这正是 AX 期望找到它的位置。

sents.en: Verify it is up before moving on:
sents.zh: 在继续之前，请先确认它已启动运行：

paragraphs.en: kubectl get svc api -n ate-system 1. Install the CLI go install github.com/google/ax/cmd/ax@latest This puts the ax binary in $(go env GOPATH)/bin . Make sure that directory is on your PATH .
paragraphs.zh: kubectl get svc api -n ate-system 1. 安装 CLI：go install github.com/google/ax/cmd/ax@latest 这会将 ax 二进制文件放入 $(go env GOPATH)/bin 。 请确保该目录位于你的 PATH 中。

sents.en: kubectl get svc api -n ate-system 1.
sents.zh: kubectl get svc api -n ate-system 1.

sents.en: Install the CLI go install github.com/google/ax/cmd/ax@latest This puts the ax binary in $(go env GOPATH)/bin .
sents.zh: 安装 CLI：go install github.com/google/ax/cmd/ax@latest 这会将 ax 二进制文件放入 $(go env GOPATH)/bin 。

sents.en: Make sure that directory is on your PATH .
sents.zh: 请确保该目录位于你的 PATH 中。

paragraphs.en: With the prerequisites in place — most importantly a reachable Agent Substrate Control API — deploy the AX control plane:
paragraphs.zh: 前置条件就绪后——最重要的是 Agent Substrate Control API 可访问——部署 AX 控制平面：

paragraphs.en: make deploy AX_IMAGE_REPO= < your-registry > This deploys Redis, then builds and deploys the control plane images with ko . Everything lands in the ax-system namespace.
paragraphs.zh: 执行 make deploy AX_IMAGE_REPO=<你的镜像仓库>，这会先部署 Redis，然后使用 ko 构建并部署控制面镜像。 所有内容都会部署到 ax-system 命名空间中。

sents.en: make deploy AX_IMAGE_REPO= < your-registry > This deploys Redis, then builds and deploys the control plane images with ko .
sents.zh: 执行 make deploy AX_IMAGE_REPO=<你的镜像仓库>，这会先部署 Redis，然后使用 ko 构建并部署控制面镜像。

sents.en: Everything lands in the ax-system namespace.
sents.zh: 所有内容都会部署到 ax-system 命名空间中。

paragraphs.en: ax apply -f examples/task.yaml # Task + Workspace + Model in one file ax get tasks # NAME ATESPACE PHASE ACTOR WORKER-IP AGE # task123 default Running task123 10.20.3.67 1m ax watch task task123 # stream phase and condition changes live ax ssh task123 -- ls -la /workspace # poke around inside the sandbox ax suspend task task123 # checkpoint and pause ax resume task task123 # pick up where it left off Want to see the whole lifecycle end to end? Run ./demo.sh . It applies a custom workspace, waits for readiness, runs commands over ax ssh , and suspends the task.
paragraphs.zh: ax apply -f examples/task.yaml # 用一个文件同时创建 Task + Workspace + Model；ax get tasks # NAME NAMESPACE PHASE ACTOR WORKER-IP AGE # task123 default Running task123 10.20.3.67 1m；ax watch task task123 # 实时查看阶段和状态变化；ax ssh task123 -- ls -la /workspace # 在沙箱里四处看看；ax suspend task task123 # 生成检查点并暂停；ax resume task task123 # 从中断处继续。想完整地端到端查看整个生命周期吗？运行 ./demo.sh。 它会应用一个自定义的工作空间，等待就绪，通过 ax ssh 运行命令，并暂停该任务。

Run ./demo.sh .

sents.en: It applies a custom workspace, waits for readiness, runs commands over ax ssh , and suspends the task.
sents.zh: 它会应用一个自定义的工作空间，等待就绪，通过 ax ssh 运行命令，并暂停该任务。

paragraphs.en: ax talks to the control plane over gRPC. It is deliberately kubectl -shaped: apply , get , describe , watch , delete , plus a few agent-specific verbs.
paragraphs.zh: ax 通过 gRPC 与控制平面通信。 它刻意设计成 kubectl 的形式：apply、get、describe、watch、delete，外加几个智能体专用的动词。

sents.en: ax talks to the control plane over gRPC.
sents.zh: ax 通过 gRPC 与控制平面通信。

sents.en: It is deliberately kubectl -shaped: apply , get , describe , watch , delete , plus a few agent-specific verbs.
sents.zh: 它刻意设计成 kubectl 的形式：apply、get、describe、watch、delete，外加几个智能体专用的动词。

paragraphs.en: # Apply anything (multi-document YAML, file or stdin) ax apply -f examples/task.yaml # Tasks ax get tasks # list ax get tasks -a my-atespace # list in another atespace ax get task task123 # full spec + live status as YAML ax describe task task123 # human-readable detail ax watch task task123 # stream status and condition transitions ax suspend task task123 # checkpoint actor state and pause ax resume task task123 # resume a suspended task ax delete task task123 # Shell into the running sandbox ax ssh task123 # interactive shell (task needs spec.debug: true) ax ssh task123 -- ls -la /workspace # one-off command ax ssh task123 -- python3 main.py # Workspaces and models follow the same pattern ax get workspaces # NAME ATESPACE GIT-REPOS MCP-SERVERS # default-workspace default 1 1 ax describe workspace default-workspace ax delete workspace default-workspace ax get models # NAME ATESPACE PROVIDER MODEL # default-model default google gemini-3.8-flash ax describe model default-model ax delete model default-model # Connection plumbing ax ctx # active kube context and how ax is reaching the control plane ax tunnel list # background tunnels (state lives in ~/.ax/tunnels) ax tunnel stop ax version Works with kubectx ax follows your active Kubernetes context. Switch clusters and ax resolves and tunnels to that cluster's control plane in the background.
paragraphs.zh: # 应用任意内容（多文档 YAML、文件或标准输入）ax apply -f examples/task.yaml # 任务 ax get tasks # 列出 ax get tasks -a my-atespace # 在另一个 atespace 中列出 ax get task task123 # 完整 spec + 实时状态（YAML 格式）ax describe task task123 # 人类可读的详情 ax watch task task123 # 实时输出状态与条件的变迁 ax suspend task task123 # 对 actor 状态做检查点并暂停 ax resume task task123 # 恢复已暂停的任务 ax delete task task123 # 进入运行中的沙箱 ax ssh task123 # 交互式 shell（任务需要 spec.debug: true）ax ssh task123 -- ls -la /workspace # 一次性命令 ax ssh task123 -- python3 main.py # 工作空间与模型遵循相同的模式 ax get workspaces # NAME ATESPACE GIT-REPOS MCP-SERVERS # default-workspace default 1 1 ax describe workspace default-workspace ax delete workspace default-workspace ax get models # NAME ATESPACE PROVIDER MODEL # default-model default google gemini-3.8-flash ax describe model default-model ax delete model default-model # 连接管理 ax ctx # 活动的 kube context 以及 ax 如何连接控制平面 ax tunnel list # 后台隧道（状态保存在 ~/.ax/tunnels）ax tunnel stop ax version 配合 kubectx 使用 ax 会跟随你当前活动的 Kubernetes context。 切换集群后，ax 会在后台解析并建立到该集群控制平面的隧道。

sents.en: Switch clusters and ax resolves and tunnels to that cluster's control plane in the background.
sents.zh: 切换集群后，ax 会在后台解析并建立到该集群控制平面的隧道。

paragraphs.en: kubectx staging-cluster ax get tasks kubectx prod-cluster ax get tasks # Or target a context without switching ax --context=dev-cluster get tasks Global flags Flag Description Default -a , --atespace Atespace scope for the command default -n , --namespace Kubernetes namespace where AX is installed ax-system --context Kubernetes context to target active kubectx / current-context --server Control plane address, bypassing auto-detection derived from kube context, or $AX_SERVER License Apache License 2.0. See LICENSE for details.
paragraphs.zh: kubectx staging-cluster ax get tasks kubectx prod-cluster ax get tasks # 无需切换即可指定目标上下文 ax --context=dev-cluster get tasks 全局标志 标志 描述 默认值 -a , --atespace 命令的 Atespace 作用范围 default -n , --namespace 安装 AX 的 Kubernetes 命名空间 ax-system --context 要指定的 Kubernetes 上下文 活动 kubectx / current-context --server 控制平面地址，绕过从 kube 上下文或 $AX_SERVER 自动检测得到的地址 许可证 Apache License 2.0。详情请参阅 LICENSE。
